narrative: 作为一种画面机制，设计一段结束状态与起始状态相匹配的运动：位置、光线、姿势都一致。剪辑点应该消失不见。
作为一种叙事机制，重复一段事件序列，同时知识或某个决定发生变化。这两者是同名的近亲。
不要把它们当成一坨东西来提示。对于一个来回往复的玩具式效果（回旋镖），或大部分静止、只有一个局部在活动的画面（微动图）来说，它就不是合适的工具。
一个同时改变所有东西的循环没有基准线。一个会闪一下的接点，只是一次剪辑而已。
how: 对于视觉循环，让首尾帧匹配，并保持动作方向始终向前。对于叙事循环，建立一个重置提示和一个稳定的基准线，然后在每个循环中只改变少量动作。
提示词：Infinite loop of [Subject], the last frame sewing to the first, a motion that never arrives.
when: 当一个动作或一天应该显得永远无法完结时使用，比如一段能够缝合起来的走路循环，或一个不断重置的早晨。当你想要回旋镖式的那种猛然回弹感时，就不要用它。
vs: 无限循环（Infinite Loop）不是回旋镖（Boomerang），回旋镖是把同一段素材倒放回去。微动图（Cinemagraph）让画面保持静止，只循环播放其中一座“动态孤岛”。
倒放（Reverse Motion）是方向问题，而不是缝合问题。叙事性循环（如《土拨鼠之日》（Groundhog Day））在一个重复的事件中改变行为。
视觉循环必须让首尾相匹配。
examples_film: GIF文化和装置录像艺术是这种视觉语法的代表：一段可以永远播放下去的动作。《土拨鼠之日》（Groundhog Day）让同一个早晨反复出现，而菲尔的行为在不断变化。
《罗拉快跑》（Run Lola Run）用不同的行动和结果重复几次尝试。《明日边缘》（Edge of Tomorrow）把重复变成了一种训练手段。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是回旋镖。破绽是能看出明显的倒放，或者重置时首尾帧并不匹配。
解决办法是让末帧匹配首帧，保持方向的一致性，并只改变你真正想改变的变量。

faq.q: 电影中的无限循环是什么？
faq.a: 无限循环要么把末帧缝合到首帧，让一个动作永不结束；要么在知识或选择发生变化的同时，重复一段事件序列。

faq.q: 无限循环和回旋镖有什么区别？
faq.a: 回旋镖沿同一路径先正放再倒放。视觉性的无限循环通常始终保持正放，并让首尾相匹配，让接点消失不见。

faq.q: 什么时候该用无限循环？
faq.a: 当时长本身不该向前推进时使用：一个无缝的循环，或一个反复出现的、能够用来比较某个已改变决定的日子。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示无限循环？
faq.a: 写明一个无缝循环，末尾与开头匹配，没有可见的剪辑点。如果你想要的是一个循环反复的日子式的故事，就说明重置提示，以及每个循环中改变了什么。

narrative: As a picture machine, design a motion whose end state matches its start: position, light, pose. The cut should vanish.
As a story machine, repeat an event sequence while knowledge or one decision changes. Those are cousins that share a name.
Do not prompt them as one blob. It is the wrong tool for a forward-back toy (boomerang) or a mostly still image with one living detail (cinemagraph).
A loop that changes everything at once has no baseline. A join that flashes is just a cut.
how: For a visual loop, match the first and last frames and keep the action forward. For a narrative loop, establish a reset cue and a stable baseline, then vary a small number of actions per cycle.
Prompt: Infinite loop of [Subject], the last frame sewing to the first, a motion that never arrives.
when: Use it when a motion or a day should fail to conclude, such as a walk cycle that sews or a morning that resets. Do not use it when you want a boomerang snap.
vs: An infinite loop is not a Boomerang, which rewinds the same samples. A Cinemagraph holds a still and loops one island of motion.
Reverse Motion is direction, not a sew. Narrative loops (Groundhog Day) change behavior inside a repeated event.
examples_film: GIF culture and installation video are the visual grammar: a motion that can play forever. Groundhog Day returns the same morning while Phil's behavior changes.
Run Lola Run repeats attempts with varied actions and outcomes. Edge of Tomorrow turns repetition into training.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Boomerang. The tell is a visible rewind, or a reset with no matching frames.
Fix: match last frame to first, keep direction consistent, and change only the variables you mean to change.

faq.q: What is Infinite Loop in film?
faq.a: An infinite loop either sews last frame to first so a motion never ends, or repeats an event sequence while knowledge or choices change.
A boomerang runs forward then backward on the same path. A visual infinite loop usually stays forward and matches its ends so the join vanishes.

faq.q: When should I use Infinite Loop?
faq.a: When duration should not progress: a seamless cycle, or a repeated day that makes one changed decision comparable.

faq.q: How do I prompt Infinite Loop for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write a seamless loop, end matching start, no visible cut. If you mean a repeated-day story, say the reset cue and what changes each cycle.
